spanish: Bandera de campamento de Rubén temánah a sus ejércitos; y príncipe a hijos de Rubén, Elitsur hijo de Shedéur.

findings.issue: Common noun (feminine singular absolute + directional suffix), not a name: left untranslated as temánah, so the licensed south/southward sense is omitted and Hebrew is dumped into Spanish.

notes: Remaining tokens match number, participants, constructs, and the verbless prince clause.
